speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: A strong defence safeguards Singapore's peace, security, and sovereignty, and lays the foundation for our pursuit of economic and social progress.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The geopolitical environment and security landscape which we face is becoming more complex, and further exacerbated by disruptions and differences brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Contestation between the US and China is rising across all spheres, while territorial, maritime, and other disputes among countries have intensified.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Sensing opportunities, terrorists and cyber-attackers continue to pose significant threats.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Across borders, the rules-based order which has contributed to global stability and multilateral institutions that have forged cooperation to transnational problems are unravelling.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Within each nation, COVID-19 is inflicting enormous health, economic, and social damage.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As we navigate through these turbulent times, the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) must stand ever prepared to defend our nation.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The SAF is also progressively restarting overseas exercises to sharpen our capability edge.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: To protect the health of our servicemen, the SAF will continue to undertake comprehensive safety measures, supported by robust COVID-19 surveillance and testing regimes.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will also comprehensively relook how we operate, train, and work, and make fundamental changes that are necessary for the new normal.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) and the SAF also remain ready to contribute to national COVID-19 efforts when called upon.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We have led national health surveillance and contact tracing operations to contain COVID-19's spread, built and managed community care and recovery facilities, and taken care of COVID-19 patients and migrant workers in dormitories.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Our defence scientists and engineers have stepped up to contribute technology and testing solutions in support of frontline operations.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Even as we face a more volatile external environment and a widening array of threats, the SAF's enlistee pool will shrink.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: It will transform its fighting concepts, restructure its units, and strengthen operations-technology integration to maintain a decisive edge over potential adversaries.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The Next-Gen SAF will be one that harnesses the power of digitalisation, autonomous and unmanned systems, and big data and artificial intelligence.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: In the cyber domain, an integrated cyber force will defend our digital borders.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The SAF's transformation is possible because of our long-term planning and steady investments over the years.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: New land, maritime, and aerial platforms, as well as Command, Control, Communications, Computers and Intelligence (C4I) systems will be progressively deployed in the coming years.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Upgraded local training facilities including SAFTI City and overseas ones such as the Shoalwater Bay Training Area in Australia will allow us to train more effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will also be strengthening our local defence ecosystem, to enable us to develop bespoke technological capabilities for the SAF, while building resilience amidst uncertainties in our global supply chains.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As we do all these, we will continue to be prudent in defence spending, taking into account the economic downturn and competing needs due to COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: NS remains the crucial backbone of Singapore's defence.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will enhance the NS system to drive the Next-Gen SAF and support the needs of a new generation of national servicemen.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The National Service Review Committee established in 2020 will develop mechanisms for better matching of skills and experience to vocations and deployment, and continual professional development of our servicemen.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will also revamp our servicemen's end-to-end NS journey for a more meaningful and efficient experience.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As a small city state, it is vital that we uphold a global system and regional security architecture that are based on openness, inclusivity, co-operation, and respect for international law.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: MINDEF and the SAF will contribute towards constructive dialogue and partnerships at multilateral platforms, including the Shangri-La Dialogue, the ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting (ADMM), the ADMM-Plus, and the Five Power Defence Arrangements (FPDA).

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will support the ADMM-Plus Experts' Working Groups' new three-year cycle of cooperative initiatives in areas such as counterterrorism and maritime security.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will reaffirm our commitment to strengthening defence consultation and cooperation with member-nations of the FPDA, which marks its 50th anniversary in 2021.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: On the bilateral front, we will continue to develop defence ties with our neighbours Malaysia and Indonesia, and other partners such as Australia, China, India, and the US.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: With the US, we will build upon the 2019 Protocol of Amendment to the 1990 Memorandum of Understanding to facilitate the US' presence in our region and work together on areas of mutual interest.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will also instil pride in and support for the institution of NS, and continue to recognise NSmen and their supportive families and employers for their sacrifices.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Together, Singaporeans will build a strong defence that keeps our families safe and our nation peaceful, and enables us to advance our lives and develop a better society.
